# AlgoRhythms file format

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:schema` from src/core/schema.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

An AlgoRhythms piece is a JSON file, usually named `*.algorhythms.json`. This page describes file format version 2. The JSON Schema at the end is generated from the Zod schema the app uses to read files, so the two cannot drift apart.

## Rules

- `format` must be `"algorhythms"` and `version` must be a whole number. Both are required; everything else has a default or is optional.
- **Defaults.** A field with a `default` in the schema may be left out; it is filled in when the file is read. Leaving out `voices` gives the default pool of 12 voices (`v1`–`v12`).
- **Unknown fields are kept.** Every object accepts extra fields, and the app writes them back when it saves. A file from a newer version survives a round trip through an older one where possible.
- **Versions.** Older files are upgraded on load, one version at a time. A file whose `version` is newer than 2 opens with a warning, and the app saves a copy instead of overwriting it. In such a file, moments of unknown types are kept but not played; in a version-2 file they are an error.
- **Ids.** Voice ids and moment ids must each be unique. Moment ids are normally 6 base62 characters, and they matter: a moment's randomness is seeded from the piece seed and its id. The pool holds at most 32 voices.
- **The start is a moment** (version 2). Every voice starts silent. A `chord` (with notes other than `current`) or a `unison` that comes when nothing is sounding brings its voices in on their notes, with no glide: a new piece opens with a one-note chord at 0. Other moments have no effect from silence. A version 1 file's `start` is upgraded to such a chord at 0 (id `start0`) that keeps each voice on its own pitch (`byVoice`, and a `{ voices }` target when needed).
- **Order matters** in `voices` (the pool index breaks ties) and in `moments` (array order breaks ties between moments at the same time).
- Times are in seconds, pitches are fractional MIDI note numbers (69 = A4), and levels are linear.

## Defaults for moment fields

A moment's `glide` is partial: missing fields come from `defaults.glide`, whose own default is `{"length":3,"jitter":0.2,"stagger":0.8,"arrive":"together","order":"random","ease":"smootherstep"}`.

| Moment type | Defaults filled in |
|---|---|
| `chord` | `voicing`: `"even"`, `assign`: `"ordered"` |
| `unison` | `pitch`: `"center"`, `octaves`: `false` |
| `split` | `voicing`: `"even"` |
| `merge` | `which`: `"top"`, `fade`: `2` |
| `shift` | `unit`: `"semitones"` |
| `spread` | `around`: `"mean"`, `snap`: `"scale"` |
| `walk` | `grid`: `1`, `density`: `0.45`, `steps`: `[-2,-1,1,2]`, `stepGlide`: `0.3` |
| `note` | (none) |
| `pin` | (none) |
| `key` | (none) |
| `level` | `over`: `1` |
| `pulse` | `step`: `0.5`, `pattern`: `[1]`, `decay`: `0.3`, `floor`: `0`, `mode`: `"together"` |
| `tune` | `notes`: `[]` |
| `progression` | `chords`: `[]`, `voicing`: `"even"`, `assign`: `"ordered"` |
| `timbre` | `fade`: `2` |

## Timbre preset files

The Sound drawer saves one timbre as a preset file, usually named `*.algorhythms-timbre.json`: an object with `format` (`"algorhythms-timbre"`), `version` (1), `name` (1–64 characters) and `timbre`, which follows the schema of a `timbres` entry below. Defaults fill missing timbre fields and unknown fields are kept, so a preset loads back exactly as it was saved. A newer `version` loads with a warning.

## JSON Schema

This is the *input* form: fields with defaults are optional here.
